caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu and crisp menma, topped with a single nori sheet. Served in a white bowl with red rim, it rests on a dark table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a thick, slightly curled slice with a glistening, tender-looking surface and a light brown, caramelized edge.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with uneven edges and visible salt crystals on its surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, cradling thin noodles and garnishes in a curved bowl.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, sliced into thin, slightly curved pieces with a fibrous, textured surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface, featuring a thin orange-red rim and subtle inner glaze.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered end.
